recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If GenomicStudy is reintroduced to the current build, preserve the existing methodType CodeSystem, ValueSet, NCBI-GTR attribution, and example binding unless Clinical Genomics makes a newer terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-37757 was a Published Clinical Genomics R5 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested terminology support for GenomicStudy.analysis.methodType, with a final resolution to add a CodeSystem and ValueSet for example method-type codes drawn from NCBI-GTR method category, major method category, and primary methodology lists.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied by f2532f7b92fa, which added FISH, karyotyping, and MSI examples to the methodType definition. The full terminology application was made on the genomicStudy_terminologyBinding branch: c75c654f6beb added the methodType ValueSet source and element binding, 49a719de5b73 renamed the ValueSet file with its XML extension, bbf996d07c52 split the local CodeSystem from the ValueSet, and ff7c5cbbec68 merged PR #2116.
additional_context: Current retained source still binds GenomicStudy.analysis.methodType to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/genomicstudy-methodtype and includes the corresponding terminology files and notes. The R5 release history exposes the same binding. Current source/fhir.ini no longer has active GenomicStudy build entries after the 2025 remove-additional-resources commit, so retained GenomicStudy source is outside the current core build. FHIR-37758 and FHIR-37759 from the same terminology-binding family already have combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested R5 change is already applied and published, and no current-build source correction is warranted.
